statement:
ReadingList: PASSED — 6 of 6

  st-001  MET       bin/test.sh:1-16 is a #!/bin/sh script that changes to the app root, activates .venv if present, and runs `pytest -q` as its last command; governed gate full: argv `sh sources/full_test.sh`, return_code 0, stdout `117 passed in 2.65s`; sources/full_test.sh:17 execs `sh bin/test.sh`, so the gate's exit code is pytest's exit code
  st-002  MET       app_server/routes/pages.py:64-73 /add calls book_service.add_book and redirects to index on success; probe: POST /add {title: Dune, author: Frank Herbert} returned 303 Location /; probe: GET / contained 'Dune' and 'Frank Herbert' -> True
  st-003  MET       persistence/schema.py:36-51 declares the list operation; persistence/sqlite.py orders by insertion, and app_server/services/books.py:29 documents 'in the order it was added'; probe: page positions of Dune, Emma, Beloved were ascending; probe: GET /books titles returned ['Dune', 'Emma', 'Beloved']
  st-004  MET       app_server/routes/pages.py:76-79 /remove/<id> calls remove_book and redirects; probe: POST /remove/<Emma id> returned 303; probe: GET / no longer contains 'Emma'; GET /books returned ['Dune', 'Beloved']
  st-005  MET       app_server/services/books.py:11-19 validate_book_input rejects blank or non-text title/author with a message naming the field; probe: {title:'', author:'X'} -> 400, reason 'title must be non-empty text'; probe: {title:'Y', author:'   '} -> 400, reason 'author must be non-empty text'; probe: {title:'Z'} -> 400, reason 'author must be non-empty text'; probe: GET /books after rejects still ['Dune', 'Beloved']
  st-006  MET       tests/test_add_book.py: add behavior tests (e.g. test_post_answers_201_with_stored_book_fields); tests/test_list_books.py: test_list_returns_titles_in_the_order_they_were_added; tests/test_remove_book.py: test_removed_book_is_absent_from_next_list_read; tests/test_reject_empty_fields.py: test_blank_or_missing_field_answers_400_with_error_message; governed gate full: 117 passed, return_code 0

criteria.rationale: bin/test.sh exists, is a POSIX sh script that runs pytest, and the governed gate `sh sources/full_test.sh` exited 0 with 117 tests passed.
evidence: bin/test.sh:1-16 is a #!/bin/sh script that changes to the app root, activates .venv if present, and runs `pytest -q` as its last command
governed gate full: argv `sh sources/full_test.sh`, return_code 0, stdout `117 passed in 2.65s`
sources/full_test.sh:17 execs `sh bin/test.sh`, so the gate's exit code is pytest's exit code

criteria.rationale: Probe POSTed a title and author to /add, got 303 back to /, and the next GET / showed both values; the book also appeared in GET /books.
evidence: app_server/routes/pages.py:64-73 /add calls book_service.add_book and redirects to index on success
probe: POST /add {title: Dune, author: Frank Herbert} returned 303 Location /
probe: GET / contained 'Dune' and 'Frank Herbert' -> True

criteria.rationale: Probe added Dune, Emma, Beloved in that order, and both the rendered page and the JSON list returned them in that order.
evidence: persistence/schema.py:36-51 declares the list operation; persistence/sqlite.py orders by insertion, and app_server/services/books.py:29 documents 'in the order it was added'
probe: page positions of Dune, Emma, Beloved were ascending
probe: GET /books titles returned ['Dune', 'Emma', 'Beloved']

criteria.rationale: Probe removed Emma through /remove/<id>, and the next page read and the next /books read both omitted it while keeping the others.
evidence: app_server/routes/pages.py:76-79 /remove/<id> calls remove_book and redirects
probe: POST /remove/<Emma id> returned 303
probe: GET / no longer contains 'Emma'; GET /books returned ['Dune', 'Beloved']

criteria.rationale: Probe submitted an empty title, a whitespace-only author, and a missing author; each was rejected with 400 and a reason naming the field, and none was stored.
evidence: app_server/services/books.py:11-19 validate_book_input rejects blank or non-text title/author with a message naming the field
probe: {title:'', author:'X'} -> 400, reason 'title must be non-empty text'
probe: {title:'Y', author:'   '} -> 400, reason 'author must be non-empty text'
probe: {title:'Z'} -> 400, reason 'author must be non-empty text'
probe: GET /books after rejects still ['Dune', 'Beloved']

criteria.rationale: Automated tests exist for each of the four named behaviors and the full suite passed in the governed gate.
evidence: tests/test_add_book.py: add behavior tests (e.g. test_post_answers_201_with_stored_book_fields)
tests/test_list_books.py: test_list_returns_titles_in_the_order_they_were_added
tests/test_remove_book.py: test_removed_book_is_absent_from_next_list_read
tests/test_reject_empty_fields.py: test_blank_or_missing_field_answers_400_with_error_message
governed gate full: 117 passed, return_code 0

improvements: README does not say how to provision the database before first run. create_app applies no schema, so a fresh DATABASE_URL serves 500 'no such table: books' until schema.sql is executed. Add a documented provisioning command (or a CLI step) to the README's Setup section.
st-001 says 'POSIX-compatible' but no machine check runs the script under a strict POSIX shell such as dash. Add that check to the suite, or name the shell it must run under.

Several criteria (st-002 to st-005) are proven only by the test suite and my probe. Adding an end-to-end test that drives the web form through a real server would make these trials observable without an ephemeral probe.
